# African Brands Congress (ABC)

> African Brands Congress is a pan-African platform that brings together brand owners, marketers, executives, regulators and investors to learn, network and celebrate African brand excellence. Tagline: Learn // Network // Celebrate.

ABC runs an annual Congress, the African Brand Leadership Merit Awards, and a Brand Showcase and Exhibition. The latest and upcoming editions, with dates, venue and theme, are always on the home page.

## Pages
- [Home](https://africanbrandscongress.org/): current or next edition, countdown, registration
- [About](https://africanbrandscongress.org/about): who ABC is, mission, objectives, organiser
- [Programmes and Speakers](https://africanbrandscongress.org/programme): themes, sessions and speakers
- [Exhibition and Sponsors](https://africanbrandscongress.org/exhibition): Brand Showcase and Exhibition, packages on enquiry
- [Awards](https://africanbrandscongress.org/awards): African Brand Leadership Merit Awards, 35 categories
- [Gallery](https://africanbrandscongress.org/gallery): past editions
- [Register](https://africanbrandscongress.org/register): attendee registration
- [News and Contact](https://africanbrandscongress.org/news-contact): announcements and contact form
